events.text:
T-152 is back in review with Bharath, and the card now matches Adi's rule that agents don't write to Usetantra repos. Committed as 380e91d6 on main, nothing pushed.

| Item | State |
|---|---|
| 1. Evidence: PR links replaced with patch files | Done. The card links all five fix patches, the CI rule patch and the patch README, all 11 evidence files exist on disk. Each label marks its PR (#160 to #165) as closed, and `bugs.json` records each one as closed. |
| 2. Spec and done-when reworded | Done. The agent flow now ends at "patch plus regression test handed to Bharath", and Bharath applies, merges and deploys. The CI item now reads "regression-test-required workflow delivered as a patch, with apply steps for Bharath". `severity.md` says the same. |
| 3. Fix step cannot push or open PRs | Done. `pipeline.py` now blocks the agent from running `git push`, `gh` and `git remote`, then saves the fix as a patch in `tantra-product-patches/` itself. The file compiles, and a search found no push or PR command left in it. I could not run the fix step end to end without a new bug to fix. |
| 4. Report and metrics.json regenerated | Done. All five bugs show "patch ready, awaiting Bharath" with time to fix "none yet". `metrics.json` now lists each bug's state and the CI patch path. |
| 5. Commit and leave in review with Bharath | Done. Owner Bharath, reviewers Bharath and Adi. The regenerated report is the first evidence link on the board, and note F-f39eaa96 is acknowledged. |
| Severity levels agreed with Bharath | Waiting on Bharath. |
| Patches applied, merged and set as a required check | Waiting on Bharath: apply with `git am`, merge, and make `regression-test-required` a required check on `development`. |
